title: Tomato Rice
steps: Cook the rice. Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion. Add chopped tomato and cook till soft. Mix in the rice.

title: Lemon Rice
steps: Fry mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves in oil. Add turmeric and cooked rice, mix well. Squeeze in lemon juice before serving.

title: Curd Rice
steps: Mash cooked rice with milk and curd until smooth. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli in oil and pour over. Chill before serving.

title: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Fry onion and whole spices in oil till fragrant. Add chopped vegetables and rice, stir for two minutes. Add water and cook until the rice is done.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside. Fry onion and carrot, add cold rice and soy sauce. Mix in the scrambled eggs and stir-fry for two more minutes.

title: Rice Uttapam
steps: Blend leftover rice with curd and a little water into a thick batter. Pour onto a hot greased pan, sprinkle chopped onion and chilli, and cook both sides until golden.

title: Coconut Rice
steps: Dry roast grated coconut lightly. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and cashews in oil, add the coconut and cooked rice. Mix well and serve warm.

title: Tamarind Rice
steps: Make a thick tamarind paste by soaking and squeezing tamarind in water. Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves, add the tamarind paste and cook till thick. Mix with cooked rice.

title: Mixed Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Chop all vegetables finely. Stir-fry them on high heat for two minutes, then add cold cooked rice. Toss everything together until heated through.

title: Rice Kheer
steps: Simmer leftover rice in milk, stirring often, until soft and creamy. Add sugar and cardamom powder, cook a few more minutes. Garnish with chopped nuts before serving.

title: Chapati Roll
steps: Mash boiled potato with chopped onion and spices to make a filling. Spread it on a chapati with ketchup and roll it up tightly. Lightly toast the roll on a pan.

title: Chapati Chips
steps: Cut leftover chapatis into triangles. Fry or bake until crisp. Sprinkle with chilli powder and salt while still hot.

title: Chapati Upma
steps: Tear the chapatis into small pieces. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion, add peas and the torn chapati. Toss gently until everything is heated and coated in the tempering.

title: Chapati Ladoo
steps: Crumble leftover chapatis into fine crumbs. Melt jaggery with ghee and mix in the crumbs and chopped nuts. Shape into small balls while warm.

title: Bread Upma
steps: Cube the bread slices. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and tomato, then add the bread cubes. Toss gently so the bread soaks up the flavour without turning mushy.

title: Bread Pakora
steps: Make a thick batter with gram flour, chilli powder and water. Dip bread slices in the batter and deep fry until golden and crisp. Serve hot with chutney.

title: Bread Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, chilli and pepper. Pour onto a hot pan, place a bread slice on top and press lightly. Flip once and cook both sides until set.

title: Bread Pudding
steps: Soak bread pieces in a mixture of milk, beaten eggs and sugar. Add a pinch of cardamom powder and bake or steam until set. Cool slightly before serving.

title: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs with milk and sugar. Dip bread slices in the mixture and pan-fry on both sides until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Bread Cutlet
steps: Mash boiled potato and peas with spices, shape into flat patties. Dip in a bread-and-water paste, coat with crumbs, and shallow fry until crisp on both sides.

title: Dal Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and dal together and pressure cook with turmeric and water until soft. Temper cumin in ghee and pour over the khichdi before serving.

title: Dal Paratha
steps: Knead wheat flour with thick leftover dal, chilli powder and ajwain into a soft dough. Roll into parathas and cook on a hot pan with a little oil until golden spots appear.

title: Dal Soup
steps: Boil dal with tomato and garlic until completely soft. Blend smooth, then simmer with cumin and pepper. Serve hot as a light soup.

title: Dal Dosa
steps: Mix leftover dal with rice flour, chilli and cumin to make a thin batter. Spread a ladleful on a hot greased pan like a dosa. Cook both sides until crisp.

title: Masoor Dal Curry
steps: Boil masoor dal with turmeric until soft. Fry onion, garlic and tomato separately, then mix into the cooked dal. Simmer for five minutes before serving.

title: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Soak and grind moong dal with ginger and chilli into a smooth batter. Spread thinly on a hot greased pan like a dosa. Cook both sides until golden.

title: Cucumber Raita
steps: Whisk curd until smooth. Add grated cucumber, roasted cumin powder and salt. Chill before serving alongside rice or paratha.

title: Lassi
steps: Blend curd, milk and sugar together until frothy. Add a pinch of cardamom powder. Serve chilled.

title: Curd Sandwich
steps: Whisk curd with chopped mint and salt to make a spread. Layer cucumber slices between bread with the curd spread. Press lightly and serve.

title: Shrikhand
steps: Hang curd in a cloth for a few hours to drain the water. Whisk the thickened curd with sugar, cardamom and a few strands of saffron. Chill before serving.

title: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer with your hands. Fry onion, tomato and chilli until soft, add turmeric, then mix in the crumbled paneer. Cook for two minutes and serve.

title: Paneer Paratha
steps: Mash paneer with chopped chilli and coriander to make a filling. Stuff it inside a wheat flour dough ball and roll into a paratha. Cook on a hot pan with a little oil until golden.

title: Pan-Fried Paneer Tikka
steps: Marinate paneer and capsicum cubes in curd, chilli powder and lemon juice for twenty minutes. Thread onto skewers or simply pan-fry until lightly charred on all sides.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook tomato and cashews together until soft, then blend into a smooth puree. Simmer the puree with butter and cream, add paneer cubes and cook for five minutes.

title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach and blend into a smooth puree. Fry onion and garlic, add the spinach puree and simmer. Add paneer cubes and a swirl of cream before serving.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil and fry garlic until fragrant. Add all the chopped vegetables and stir-fry on high heat for five minutes so they stay crunchy. Season with soy sauce.

title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry onion and tomato into a base gravy. Add chopped mixed vegetables and a little water, then cover and cook until all the vegetables are tender.

title: Aloo Sabzi
steps: Boil and cube the potatoes. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add onion and turmeric, then toss in the potato cubes until coated and lightly fried.

title: Carrot and Peas Poriyal
steps: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil. Add chopped carrot and peas with a splash of water, cover and cook until tender. Mix in grated coconut before serving.

title: Palak Dal
steps: Boil toor dal with turmeric until soft. Add chopped spinach and cook until wilted. Temper garlic and cumin in oil and pour over the dal.

title: Cabbage Thoran
steps: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli in oil. Add finely chopped cabbage and cook on medium heat until soft. Mix in grated coconut at the end.

title: Banana Smoothie
steps: Peel and chop the banana. Blend it with milk, sugar and a pinch of cardamom powder until smooth. Serve chilled.

title: Mixed Fruit Salad
steps: Chop all the fruits into bite-sized pieces. Mix them in a bowl and drizzle with honey. Chill briefly before serving.

title: Apple Chutney
steps: Chop the apple into small pieces and cook with sugar and a splash of water until soft. Add lemon juice and a pinch of cinnamon, then mash lightly. Cool before serving.

title: Banana Pancake
steps: Mash the banana and mix with wheat flour, milk and sugar into a smooth batter. Pour spoonfuls onto a hot greased pan and cook both sides until golden.

title: Mixed Fruit Raita
steps: Whisk curd with a little sugar until smooth. Fold in chopped banana, apple and pomegranate seeds. Chill before serving.

title: Vegetable Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and dal together. Pressure cook with chopped carrot, peas and turmeric until everything is soft and well combined. Serve hot with a drizzle of ghee.

title: Onion Tomato Chutney
steps: Fry onion, tomato, garlic and red chilli together until soft. Cool and grind into a coarse paste. Temper mustard seeds in oil and mix into the chutney.

title: Buttermilk
steps: Whisk curd with water until thin and smooth. Add grated ginger, torn curry leaves and salt. Serve chilled.

title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Boil all the chopped vegetables with garlic until soft. Blend lightly or leave chunky, depending on preference. Season with pepper and simmer for a few more minutes.
